summary: Lifeway Foods, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a supplement to its definitive proxy statement for the June 17, 2026 annual meeting. The supplement adds Jason Scher as a director nominee (Proposal Four) and rescinds a prior board-size reduction from eight to seven directors, keeping the board at eight. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or shareholder activism is involved. This is a routine procedural update to a proxy solicitation, not a special situation. Shareholders should read the proxy materials; no event-driven or arbitrage angle applies.
